push.title: W 2-1 vs Warrior Minded | You: 7.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.5. You were reliable as a porch light, and that matters more than you know.

THE GOOD
+ Won 3 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 12%). That's a tackle that deserves its own highlight reel.
+ A goal against Warrior Minded, your first since Oct 6. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. You earned that one the honest way.
+ Team-high 22 passes attempted. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Training homework: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Fix it and forget it.
- Rating came in 0.9 below what your on-ball stats earned. Key note: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks. Patience, partner.
- forcing passes snagged you and PhogsToffees both. Buddy system: give each other short options.
- Tackles attempted: 3. The bar for top midfielders is 6+. Go clear it.
- Key passes: 0. Middle of the pack for a midfielder; the top quarter hits 2+. Room to climb.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (12 of 22). No excuses on that one. None. Repeat after me: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Coach's drill: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

Last thing, BellyTb1. The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Keep your head up and your feet moving. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.3. Not flashy, just useful, and useful wins matches.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 22%). You defended like you were protecting the last slice of pie.
+ A goal against Warrior Minded, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ Pass accuracy 71%, up from your usual 55%. Proof you've got another gear.
+ 2-1 win. The locker room's gonna be loud.

- Only 14 passes. Try this: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- Rating came in 0.8 below what your on-ball stats earned. One more thing: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Fundamentals: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 4). That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Lowest tackles won on the team: 2 (best was BellyTb1's 3). Let's turn that around by next session.

Warm-up idea: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

tuxedo_slide, one more thing before you log off: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

We'll sharpen it at practice. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-1 vs Warrior Minded | You: 7.3
push.body:
A 7.3, PhogsToffees. That's a B-plus kind of day, and I happen to love B-plus days.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ Tackle success 50%, up from your usual 22%. You earned that one the honest way.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ Won your matchup: 7.3 against their best forward's 6.1. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ Team-high 13 completed passes. Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Real talk: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. We'll get there together.
- 62% passing (13 of 21, down from your usual 77%). Next match: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- You and BellyTb1 share the forcing passes homework. Study group: give each other short options.
- 0.4 below average. The fight's still in you; I saw it.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was BellyTb1's 0). That's the gap between a good night and a great one.

Drill of the day: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Learn it, then leave it. - Coach Lasso
